profile.headline: Software Engineer at Rewards Network
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer that loves to build beautiful and impactful applications. I take pride in building things people will use and working on challenging and difficult problems that require solutions while also trying to keep those solutions as simple as possible.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Created launch tools for solutions teams to onboard thousands of restaurants and merchants.
* Made improvements to menu ingestions, enterprise and SMB integrations for jobs that ran hundreds of thousands times per day using Ruby on Rails, Postgres and Sidekiq.
* Led integration work for Papa John’s and contributed to new enterprise integrations (Python) as well as transitioning existing Ruby on Rails integrations to AWS Python Lambdas.
* Implemented an internal throttler for a shared gateway to allow our lambdas to not overwhelm internal and external services (Java/Kotlin).
* Responsible for maintaining security updates for known CVEs for several major applications (Ruby/Java/Kotlin/Scala/Python/Javascript)
Performed on call duties using tools and services such as Datadog, Splunk, AWS to monitor app health and led deployments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Acted as team lead for a team of four engineers overseeing pull requests, code reviews, sprint planning and reporting team progress in product meetings and to management.
* Created a recursive front-end component to allow partners to create a community generating multiple $500k contracts from outside partners.
* Added new features to AVIA Connect including adding in organizational workspaces and groups to manage events, overhauling onboarding experience for new users, sending weekly digest emails to users, and reworking of solution company profiles to attract more companies on the platform (Node/Angular)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Created system to convert application data into an appropriate format to send through the DTCC to insurance companies.
* Set up a scheduled application to transmit and receive application data through the DTCC.
* Made improvements and fixed existing issues across all stacks using rails, marionette.js, ember, react and HTML/CSS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Company exited and merged with RetireUp
* Began implementation of a system to convert RepPro application data into an appropriate format to send through the DTCC to insurance companies.
* Made a theming template to display a different set of HTML/CSS depending on if a user was a RepPro user or RetireUp Pro user.  
* Made improvements and fixed existing issues across all stacks using rails, marionette.js, ember, react and HTML/CSS.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created a micro-site to layer PokéDates on existing Project Fixup engine to enable Project Fixup to pivot and launch PokéDates. 
• Updated legacy code and services to external APIs to allow more users to access the site and improved the signup experience for domestic and international users. 
• Built new API using Django Rest Framework and token authentication for mobile applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Optimized python models and reduced redundant queries to improve load times of Edomodo product pages by 50% 
• Redesigned file permissions using Go and a polymorphic join table to enable over 60 million users to set specific file sharing permissions
• Worked on several different stacks with different environments and languages including python, backbone.js, go and ruby.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Dev Bootcamp is an intensive 19 week program that focuses on learning Ruby, JavaScript, ActiveRecord, Sinatra and Ruby on Rails. 

• Over 1000 hours dedicated to coding challenges, group projects, individual projects, and self guided learning.
• Over 500 hours in paired programming sessions.
• Web applications using Ruby on Rails, Javascript, HTML5 / CSS3, jQuery, AJAX, ActiveRecord, and Sinatra.
• Best practices for Object Oriented Design (OO), Model View Controller (MVC), and RESTful patterns.
•Test-driven development (TDD) using RSpec.
• Object-relational database management systems (ORDBMS) including Postgres (PostgresSQL) and SQLite (SQLite3).
• Learned and practiced engineering empathy.
• Lead and worked on teams using an Agile Development approach.

positions.title: Civil Engineer
positions.description:
I worked as a Civil Engineer focussing on road design for the Illiana corridor and I-90 projects.

•	Prepared existing and proposed drainage plans and assisted in preparation of hydraulic reports.
•	Coordinate between tasks to complete pollutant load analysis of Illiana corridor.
•	Prepared erosion control, landscaping plans, pavement marking and signing plans for I-90
•	Assisted in developing roadway plans for I-90.
•	Created numerous informational exhibits for meetings.
•	Created several base files and helped set CAD standards on projects.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performs on site measurements, records data, calculates field quantities and creates preliminary layout and quantity estimates for road construction.
•	Obtains traffic data for municipal, county and state roads.
•	Performs surveying to establish existing conditions of the road.
•	Designs SMART projects using MicroStation and GEOPAK.

positions.title: Field Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Assisted Engineers in performing on site measurements, recording data, calculating field quantities and created preliminary layout and quantity estimates.
•	Inspected the work of contractors to ensure the service they provided met or exceeded the specified standards for safety and quality.  Some of the various inspection tasks included milling, paving, curb and gutter removal/replacement/striping.
•	Partook in several resurfacing projects in McHenry County.
•	Oversaw and coordinated efforts of team members on projects.  Determined the work being performed and assigned team members accordingly to monitor different tasks.

positions.title: Field Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Assisted Engineers in performing on site measurements, recording data, calculating field quantities and created preliminary layout and quantity estimates.
•	Inspected the work of contractors to ensure the service they provided met or exceeded the specified standards for safety and quality.  Some of the various inspection tasks included milling, paving, curb and gutter removal/replacement/striping.
•	Partook in several resurfacing projects in McHenry County.
•	Oversaw and coordinated efforts of team members on projects.  Determined the work being performed and assigned team members accordingly to monitor different tasks.

positions.title: Lab Assistant
positions.description:
•	Performed a variety of physical, analytical and organoleptic tests on numerous national brand and private label household products in support of the Product Analysts.
•	Utilized a variety of lab instrumentation, including pH meter, spectrophotometer, turbidimeter, refractometer, and densitometer.

projects.title: ESPORTAL
projects.description: I served as the project lead on this project; using agile development we created this rails app.  Completed in just over a week, it makes tracking and following of e-sports tournaments easy.  By providing people a way to filter and see upcoming tournaments for different games and allowing them to subscribe to a tournament they are interested by adding it to their personal google calendar in one click.

projects.title: GIF-tly
projects.description: A web application on the sinatra framework, accomplished using the Giphy and Twilio API. This project allows a user to send holiday text messages to another user's phone. This text message would include a holiday greeting attached with a holiday GIF.
